description: Build a Kayak.com flight-search deep link for a route and dates. Returns the URL only — no prices: Kayak renders fares client-side behind bot protection, so a server-side fetch can't read them. Open deep_link in a browser for live results, or use google_flights_search for parsed fares. Result shape: { source, deep_link, search_url, trip_type, origin, destination, departure_date, return_date, cabin_class, adults, note } — a single object, never a list: there are no fares, flights or offers to read. `deep_link` (identical to `search_url`) is the only useful output; `return_date` is null for a one-way.

destination.description: Destination airport IATA code (3-letter, e.g. JFK).

origin.description: Origin airport IATA code (3-letter, e.g. WAW).

return_date.description: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for one-way.

name: kayak_search_flights
title: Build a Kayak flight-search deep link
